entities.name: Hana Dostalová
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hana Dostalová (1890–1981) was a Czech painter, illustrator, textile and glass designer. She was the daughter of actress Marie Horská-Kallmünzerová, sister of actress Leopolda Dostalová and director Karel Dostal.
